front_matter.text: SURYA ADJIE UMAR TENDA, Rancang Bangun Aplikasi Web Pembelajaran Bahasa Isyarat Indonesia (BISINDO) Interaktif dengan Deteksi Gestur Real-Time (dibimbing oleh Pembimbing I dan Pembimbing II).

runs.text: , Rancang Bangun Aplikasi Web Pembelajaran Bahasa Isyarat Indonesia (BISINDO) Interaktif dengan Deteksi Gestur Real-Time (dibimbing oleh Pembimbing I dan Pembimbing II).

front_matter.text: Bahasa Isyarat Indonesia (BISINDO) merupakan bahasa utama yang digunakan komunitas Tuli di Indonesia, namun aksesibilitas pembelajarannya masih terbatas, khususnya di Sulawesi Utara. Penelitian ini bertujuan merancang dan membangun aplikasi web pembelajaran BISINDO interaktif yang memberikan umpan balik real-time terhadap gerakan isyarat pengguna melalui webcam. Sistem memanfaatkan MediaPipe Hand Landmarker untuk mengekstraksi 21 titik landmark tangan dan mengklasifikasikannya menggunakan model deep learning berparadigma low-parameter: Convolutional Neural Network satu dimensi (Conv1D) untuk gestur statis serta Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) untuk gestur dinamis. Seluruh inferensi model berjalan di sisi klien melalui TensorFlow.js sehingga aplikasi dapat diakses tanpa instalasi tambahan. Aplikasi dibangun dengan React pada sisi antarmuka, Node.js/Express pada sisi layanan API, dan SQLite sebagai basis data, dengan autentikasi berbasis JSON Web Token (JWT). Hasil pelatihan menunjukkan akurasi validasi 97,64% untuk model alfabet (26 kelas), 98,01% untuk model angka statis (11 kelas), 87,69% untuk model angka dinamis (10 kelas), dan 99,26% untuk model kata dasar (17 kelas), dengan ukuran model antara 168 KB hingga 650 KB. Algoritma stabilisasi prediksi berbasis ambang keyakinan 0,8, konsistensi tiga tick, dan penghalusan Exponential Moving Average terbukti menghasilkan umpan balik yang stabil dan responsif. Pengujian fungsional menunjukkan seluruh fitur berjalan sesuai spesifikasi, dan evaluasi usability menggunakan System Usability Scale terhadap 15 responden menghasilkan skor rata-rata 86,17 (kategori Excellent). Aplikasi ini diharapkan meningkatkan aksesibilitas pembelajaran BISINDO dan mendukung inklusi sosial komunitas Tuli di Indonesia.

front_matter.text: SURYA ADJIE UMAR TENDA, Design and Development of an Interactive Web-Based Indonesian Sign Language (BISINDO) Learning Application with Real-Time Gesture Detection (supervised by Advisor I and Advisor II).

runs.text: , Design and Development of an Interactive Web-Based Indonesian Sign Language (BISINDO) Learning Application with Real-Time Gesture Detection (supervised by Advisor I and Advisor II).

front_matter.text: Indonesian Sign Language (BISINDO) is the primary language used by the Deaf community in Indonesia; however, access to BISINDO learning remains limited, particularly in North Sulawesi. This research aims to design and develop an interactive web-based BISINDO learning application that provides real-time feedback on users’ sign gestures through a webcam. The system utilizes the MediaPipe Hand Landmarker to extract 21 hand landmarks and classifies them using low-parameter deep learning models: a one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (Conv1D) for static gestures and a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network for dynamic gestures. All model inference runs on the client side through TensorFlow.js, allowing the application to be accessed without additional installation. The application is built with React for the user interface, Node.js/Express for the API service, and SQLite as the database, secured with JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication. Training results show validation accuracies of 97.64% for the alphabet model (26 classes), 98.01% for the static number model (11 classes), 87.69% for the dynamic number model (10 classes), and 99.26% for the basic words model (17 classes), with model sizes ranging from 168 KB to 650 KB. A prediction stabilization algorithm based on a 0.8 confidence threshold, three-tick consistency, and Exponential Moving Average smoothing produces stable and responsive feedback. Functional testing shows that all features work according to specifications, and a usability evaluation using the System Usability Scale with 15 respondents yielded an average score of 86.17 (Excellent category). This application is expected to improve the accessibility of BISINDO learning and support the social inclusion of the Deaf community in Indonesia.
